final: WITH g AS (SELECT SUM(amount) AS s FROM income GROUP BY COALESCE(NULLIF(link_to_member,''),'__none__')), t AS (SELECT SUM(s) AS tot FROM g), sh AS (SELECT g.s AS s, g.s*1.0/t.tot AS share FROM g, t), a AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS av FROM sh) SELECT SUM(s) AS total_amount, (SELECT av FROM a) AS avg_share, AVG(share-(SELECT av FROM a)) AS avg_share_minus_avg FROM sh WHERE share > (SELECT av FROM a)
